connections.description: The LLeMbas server this machine is logged in to, as `lembas login` writes it: its address and this machine's token. Its models come from it at every start.

type.description: A LLeMbas instance: its models, their settings, its voice and its web search.

api_key.description: This machine's token, as login wrote it: {file:~/.config/lembas/lembas/<name>.key}.

tls.description: For an instance behind a private CA: `ca`, the PEM file that signed its certificate.

timeout.description: Seconds of silence allowed in a reply, as for any connection (default 600).

quirks.description: Server oddities; auto is right almost always.

stream_usage.description: Ask for token usage in the stream (stream_options); auto learns when a server refuses it.

prompt_progress.description: Ask how far the server is through reading the prompt (llama.cpp's return_progress), shown while it reads; auto learns when a server refuses it, and one that ignores it shows nothing.

think_tags.description: <think>…</think> in a reply is taken as reasoning; off leaves it as text.

max_tokens_field.description: OpenAI reasoning models refuse `max_tokens`; most local servers only know it.

models.description: Only to change what the instance says about a model, here: each entry goes over the instance's. Usually absent.

name.description: A display name; the id is what is sent.

family.description: Picks the prompt overlay: anthropic | gpt | gemini | local. Guessed from the id when absent.

context.description: Total context window in tokens. 0 / absent = unknown: no percentage, no auto-compaction.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; absent = the server's default.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling; absent = the server's default.

efforts.description: The model's own effort vocabulary, in offering order.

effort_style.description: Where the effort goes in a request: top-level, in chat_template_kwargs, or both (the default: llama.cpp drops top-level).

vision.description: The model reads images: @image files, pasted paths and view_image.

tools.description: false: a model without tool calls — it can only talk.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for this model's requests.

body.description: Merged into every request body for this model.

notes.description: What this model is good at, in a line: the model in use is told which others there are, for handing work over (task) or switching.

single_session.description: The server serves one request at a time: a subagent on this same model would take its only slot and push the session's cached prompt out, so it is refused.

group.description: Models sharing one GPU server that holds one model at a time (llama-swap), as the LLeMbas server says (capacity.group): a subagent on another model of the same group would unload this one, so it is refused.

title: LLeMbas CLI connections.yaml
description: ~/.config/lembas/connections.yaml: the LLeMbas server this machine is logged in to, as lembas login writes it. Global only.
